description: Read ONE automatic store notification (order status, verification code/OTP, welcome, review request …) in full: its message text in every language, its image/video/file, whether it is on, and its WhatsApp (Meta) approval. Pass the id from list_store_automations (kind notification_template), or the store module + event slug (e.g. module "salla", slug "otp" or "completed").

module.description: Store module when looking up by slug, e.g. "salla".

slug.description: Event slug when no id is known, e.g. "otp", "completed", "customer_created".

name: get_notification_template
